name: GENEB leaderboard
description: Frozen-embedding probing benchmark of genomic foundation models over 100 tasks in 13 categories, with full-data, 10-shot and 1-shot regimes.

attributes.task: Genomic sequence classification from frozen embeddings
attributes.scope_note: MCC aggregates only: micro average over all 100 tasks, macro average (unweighted mean of the 13 category MCCs), and per category.

name: GENEB leaderboard, 10-shot, MCC aggregates
description: GENEB probing of frozen embeddings, 10-shot regime.

attributes.protocol: Logistic-regression probe (max_iter=1000) on frozen embeddings, trained per task in the 10-shot regime; MCC aggregated as the micro average over all 100 tasks, the macro average (unweighted mean of the 13 category MCCs) and per category.
limitations: Leaderboard aggregates; per-task values not extracted.
